handback.t:
All six docs are written, committed and pushed to `master` (https://github.com/socrates6969/provider-data-accuracy.git, commits 672e7cc and f891136). The report is at `scratchpad\build-provider-docs.md`. I did not run the tests or the code.

**Files**, all under `C:\Users\mariu\ventures\provider-data-accuracy`: `business/business-plan.md`, `business/market-analysis.md`, `financial/model.md`, `technical/overview.md`, `fundraising/README.md`, `hiring/README.md`.

**Web search:** the budget was exhausted (200 of 200), so every figure comes from prior knowledge and is graded and flagged as unverified in the docs.
- **CAQH 2019 survey:** the $2.76-4B figure is grade B. I did not open the primary, and the docs call it a cost borne mostly by practices, not a market size.
- **$17B:** grade C, excluded from every headline and model.
- **CMS directory error rates and the No Surprises Act verification cadences:** grade C and flagged. The cadences must be checked against the statute before any pitch.

**Existing code:** the repo already had an offline MVP in `src/provider_data_accuracy/` (about 850 lines, 12 tests, FastAPI plus CLI). It appeared while I was working and was not there when I first listed the tree. My first commit (672e7cc) swept it in, because I ran `git add -A` before noticing. I then rewrote `technical/overview.md` to match it, and corrected the "zero code" and "no code" wording in the business plan and fundraising doc. Per the code:
- The matching and rules are labeled illustrative, and the reference data is a synthetic stub.
- The live NPPES provider raises `NotImplementedError`.
- Nothing has ever run on a real roster.

**Model, on assumed inputs:**

| Scenario | Annual contract value | Year-5 run-rate | Valuation at 8-15x |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base | $18K | $5.9M | $47-89M |
| Bull | $30K | $19.5M | $156-293M |
| Bear | $10K | $0.7M | $6-11M |

- **$1B:** no scenario reaches it. It would need $67-125M of annual recurring revenue, roughly 2,200-6,900 accounts.
- **Base-case unit economics:** LTV:CAC is 4.5x.
- **Capital:** seed of $1.5-2.5M. Base-case run-rate reaches the typical $2-4M Series A bar in Year 4.

**Other contents:**
- **Competitors:** the teardown covers all nine you named.
- **Wedge:** small payers and delegated entities, specialty groups, and directory-accuracy mandates.
- **Fundraising:** health-tech VCs, a Nordic and Norway section, official channels only, two templates, no personal details. It says plainly that the modest ceiling will make many funds pass.
- **Hiring:** four roles, including a Norway-based operator/CEO and a healthcare-data domain lead. Sourcing is via recruiters and official channels, with no dossiers.
- **#1 milestone (Gate G0):** measure match and correction accuracy on a real roster against independently verified ground truth, before selling anything. The pass/fail bars are to be fixed in advance.
- **Compliance:** the docs say the product is not clinical advice and is not primary-source verification unless a customer's compliance team accepts our evidence for that.
